content.text:
Wolfram|Alpha gives the area of a regular hexagon with side length 7 cm as **(147√3)/2 cm² ≈ 127.306 cm²**.

I got there by loading the query `area of a regular hexagon with side length 7 cm` from the site. Typing into the homepage search box did not submit reliably, so I went to the query URL directly. The result pod read as `(147 sqrt(3))/2 cm^2 ≈ 127.306 cm^2`. The unit conversions also show 0.01273 m² and 12731 mm². This matches the formula (3√3/2)·s² with s = 7.
